project.name: NamastePOS
project.idea: Mobile-first, offline-ready restaurant POS & billing SaaS for India: billing, KOT/KDS, table & captain modes, QR self-ordering, GST-compliant invoicing, loyalty/wallet, live reports from any Android phone — keeps working when the internet drops.

phases.summary: Vision locked: 'Run your restaurant, not your software.' Offline-first, phone-is-the-till, GST built in, all-inclusive pricing, growth tools included.
Stack: Node 22 + Postgres 14 backend, Flutter 3.44 POS app, web dashboard + platform admin, Razorpay subscriptions, Cloudflare R2 for APK. 5-tier plan ladder billed per register.
PRD in .agents/product-marketing.md v1.0.2: ICP (single-outlet Indian food businesses), JTBD, positioning, proof rules.
Multi-tenant architecture: tenant-scoped SQL, server-authoritative pricing, idempotent offline order replay, 102 forward-only migrations, 51 gated feature keys.
Product live in production (namastepos.in, app., api., admin.). 1,569 automated tests passing.
Quality gates: automated suite, deploy verified by curl /v1/health, CODE_REVIEW_2026-09-05 completed, 2FA on admin, DPDP console.
Deployed: multi-tenant, auto-deploying. Android APK published; iOS via dev build (App Store pending).
Go-to-market in progress via MarketingAlia: latest run overall 77/100. Blocked on founder actions (Razorpay KYC, directory logins).

A.programming_language: TypeScript/Node 22 (backend), Flutter 3.44 (POS app), web dashboard + admin, Postgres 14
A.original_requirements: Restaurant billing that just works — mobile-first, offline-ready, built for India.
A.product_goals:
Bill fast during the rush even when the WiFi dies (offline-first, idempotent replay)
GST-correct bills without thinking about CGST/SGST/HSN (server-authoritative pricing, e-invoice ready)
All-inclusive transparent pricing: free-forever Starter, paid from ₹299/mo, live reports on every plan, no lock-in
A.user_stories:
As a single-outlet owner, I want to bill from my Android phone during a rush so that I never need a PC or live internet
As an owner, I want GST/HSN applied per item automatically so that every bill is a valid legal document
As a captain, I want to take orders at the table from my phone so that the kitchen sees them instantly (KOT/KDS)
As an owner, I want loyalty, memberships, wallet and WhatsApp receipts built in so that diners come back without another tool
As a small-chain owner (2–5 outlets), I want HQ-synced menus/plans/staff and consolidated reports
A.competitive_analysis:
Legacy desktop POS (annual lock-in): Windows PC + live internet assumed; report paywalls; ₹14–18k/yr upfront
Commission-taking online-ordering tools: easy start; take a cut of every order
Paper + calculator: free; no GST correctness, no reports
(Internal only — never name competitors publicly: Petpooja, Posist/Restroworks, Rista, DotPe)

B.implementation_approach: Multi-tenant SaaS. Node 22 API (api.namastepos.in) over Postgres 14 with tenant-scoped SQL and forward-only migrations; Flutter POS app writes orders locally and replays on reconnect with idempotency keys; web dashboard and platform admin as separate front-ends; Razorpay subscriptions with timing-safe webhook HMAC; WhatsApp receipts; QR dine-in; print agent for thermal printers; landing + blog static site.

sequenceDiagram

  participant API as Node API
  participant DB as Postgres
  App->>App: write order locally (idempotencyKey)
  App->>API: POST /v1/orders (on reconnect, replay)

  API->>WhatsApp: receipt
  Razorpay->>API: webhook payment.failed (HMAC)
  API->>DB: UPDATE subscriptions SET dunning_step=n WHERE dunning_step < n

adrs.title: Offline-first with idempotent order replay
adrs.decision: Orders are written locally on the phone and replayed on reconnect keyed by an idempotency key, so a replay can never double-charge. Consequence: the network can drop mid-service without losing bills.

adrs.title: Server-authoritative pricing and GST
adrs.decision: Prices, GST rates and HSN come from the server, never the client; a bill is a legal document. Landing pricing renders from /v1/public/plans for the same reason.

adrs.title: Tenant per outlet, grouped for chains
adrs.decision: Each outlet is a fully isolated tenant under one group; plans and staff sync from HQ. Consequence: multi-outlet without cross-tenant data risk.

adrs.title: Dunning as a scheduled 4-touch ladder
adrs.decision: Steps advance only via UPDATE WHERE dunning_step < n, scheduled as fractions of the grace window. Replaces one-email-per-payment.failed which sent duplicates.

adrs.title: No competitor names in public copy
adrs.decision: Use 'legacy POS' / 'desktop POS' / 'annual-lock-in POS'. Internal notes only in research/.
